parsed.faithful: But Nyte, Cynthius aurem Vellit,——— VIRG. and demands justice for his favourite, and ours. Great things he has done; but he might have done greater. What a fall is it from Homer's numbers, free as air, lofty and harmonious as the spheres, into childish faces, and tinkling sounds! But, in his fall, he is still great;———
